title: desktop jam
pitch: tap your desktop icons until they leave. final_FINAL_v3.docx is in the way. it always is.
controls: tap or click an icon to slide it off in its arrow's direction. keyboard: arrows move the cursor, enter/space taps, r restarts, p pauses, m mutes.
changelog: v2: 50 levels in 5 worlds (system files, 2-cell windows, locks + admin.key, spinning .exe that can jam you), solver-checked levels, harder one-shot daily, restart/pause end-delay fixes.

playtest.notes: after score is from the v2 replay, before the small v2.1 fixes (spinners in worlds 2-4, next-direction ghost arrow, daily one-shot + versioned save, toast/focus fixes)
